suggested_change: Clarify: (1) Criterion 2 exception—state explicitly whether carry-forward language is acceptable when only 1 call exists; (2) Criterion 3—define score thresholds (is 'no named competitors' = 2/10 or 4/10?); (3) Criterion 4—confirm whether '[contact TBD]' or reasonable inference (Christian from call 1) is preferred when transcript incomplete; (4) Criterion 5—specify ICP validation scope (must analyst explicitly state pass/fail, or is absence of contradictory data acceptable?). Current rubric creates conflicting signals about what constitutes acceptable output.
